newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Persetel cautions it in talks.
newsitem.headline: Persetel cautions it in talks.

text.p: Acquisitive South African information technology firm Persetel Holdings Ltd said on Friday it was in talks, which if successfully concluded, could have an effect on its Johannesburg share price.

No further details were given in the brief announcement, but the group, which on Thursday released year end results, said then that it planned to keep buying companies in pursuit of earnings outside of South Africa.
It said that this high level of investment could impact on short-term earnings growth.
Persetel, which posted a 52 percent rise in 1996/97 earnings per share to 70.1 cents, said that it was now earning around 60 percent of profits outside it home country.
Shareholders were advised to exercise caution in their share dealings.
